rv.q: The current production, Sweat (the 2017. Pulitzer prize-winning play written by Lynn Nottage under the emotional and heart stopping direction of Andrea J. Dymond) grabs your brain, heart and soul from the first scene.
In this exciting, Pulitzer Prize-winning play, Lynn Nottage shows why she’s earned the title of one of the finest living contemporary playwrights in America.
Dymond’s spirited and talented cast utilize to play close to the audience.
You should take advantage of this exceptional production and go at once.
The fight choreography by David Woolley was powerful and will cause you to grab your seat arms.

cn.t: Nottage's Pulitzer-winning drama about working-class America receives strong praise for its emotional power and riveting performances, with critics equally impressed by the new Copley Theatre's intimate, state-of-the-art venue.
